scope: DL1 staged SOIC-to-DIP logic conversion of the reference FD1 netlist. Pin/net/footprint checks only; integrated timing and physical qualification pending. Owned-memory architecture changes are separate.

CD74AC175M96.reason: Same four D flip-flops, active-low asynchronous clear, Q and inverted Q, same pin numbering. ACT TTL thresholds and timing require new integration checks.
CD74AC175M96.sourcing: Zero owned, explicitly confirmed by user. Source 48 for this DL1 candidate. Active PDIP listed in TI addendum; distributor stock not confirmed.

CD74HCT154M96.reason: Same HCT decoder in documented wide DIP-24 package. E is 600 mil; EN is a different 300-mil package.
CD74HCT154M96.sourcing: Owned alternative: 74HCT154N DIP-24; manufacturer/logo and count pending. Historical Philips documentation found. Four positions; exact vendor timing review needed before changing selected identity.

CD74HCT161M96.reason: Same counter and pin functions in DIP. Exact selected marking is owned.
CD74HCT161M96.sourcing: CD74HCT161E ownership confirmed; count unknown. Five candidate positions.

CD74HCT377M96.reason: Same HCT enabled register and pin functions in DIP. Latest owned marking is SN74HC377N, which has CMOS input thresholds.
CD74HCT377M96.sourcing: Owned alternative: SN74HC377N, count unknown; earlier HCT377 report corrected. Pin-derived review finds CMOS-output drivers, making reuse plausible; loaded-signal and timing checks pending. Selected HCT377 ownership unconfirmed.

SN74AHCT00DR.reason: Same AHCT NAND function in documented DIP-14 package.
SN74AHCT00DR.sourcing: Owned alternative: SN74HCT00N, count unknown. HCT delay up to 25 ns at 4.5 V/50 pF/-40..85 C versus reference AHCT 9 ns; timing review required. AHCT ownership unconfirmed.

SN74AHCT08DR.reason: Same AHCT AND function in documented DIP-14 package.
SN74AHCT08DR.sourcing: Owned alternative: SN74HCT08N, count unknown. HCT delay up to 30 ns at 4.5 V/50 pF/-40..85 C versus reference AHCT 9 ns; timing review required. AHCT ownership unconfirmed.

act175_limits.document: SCHS345A, May 2024, pages 3-9 and orderable addendum
act175_limits.conditions: 4.5..5.5 V, -55..125 C, CL=50 pF; test edges 3 ns. Operating input transition limit 10 ns/V.
act175_limits.scope: Reviewed component limits, not a promoted system timing model. Recompute hold, clear/recovery, clock receiver thresholds, loaded edges and supply current. AC175 analogue results cannot be inherited.

decision.selected: Pin-compatible ACT175 DIP conversion before register consolidation
alternatives: HCT574 register redesign with new reset/inverted-output logic
Eight-bit resettable 273 registers after clock/reset grouping and rewiring
decision.rationale: ACT175 preserves asynchronous reset and both output polarities used in the netlist, with current manufacturer PDIP evidence. HCT574 is owned but has no reset and no complementary outputs.
decision.jev: Guidance skill unavailable; no Jev MCP interface/resources exposed. Continued with datasheet and netlist evidence; no advisory result claimed.
